n67c1f5c8dc.headline: January 1, 2017, industrial gas price set at USD 6 per MMBtu
n67c1f5c8dc.summary: Indonesia's Ministry of Industry set the industrial gas price at USD 6 per MMBtu, but prices in neighboring countries remain lower, prompting the government to seek ways to comply with the president's request.
n67c1f5c8dc.why: Industrial gas pricing affects manufacturing costs and competitiveness in Indonesia's economy.
